en: Sepia-toned postcard showing a busy artists' studio or film set. Several men in white coats and hats sit and stand around sketching or working, while a woman in a dramatic dark dress and large hat poses at the right, holding a painter's palette. Framed pictures and canvases line the back wall, with studio equipment and a camera tripod visible. At the top right is small printed text naming two people, and at the bottom right is a German caption.
